name: CoinDuel — Art Pipeline (Raw Upload → QA → Approved/Rejected)

meta.description: HITL art pipeline: watch 01_Raw_Upload, resolve the asset against Google Sheets, run the Python cutout+QA+paper-cut service, then route to 02_Approved_Assets or 99_Rejected and write the verdict back to the sheet.

nodes.name: Drive: Raw Upload
nodes.notes: Watch the 01_Raw_Upload folder. Duplicate this node with event=fileUpdated if employees overwrite files instead of creating new ones.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: includeOtherFields=true is REQUIRED: without it this Set node replaces the item with only the Config fields, so Parse Filename never sees the Drive file name and every upload is rejected as 'invalid filename'.

nodes.name: Sheets: Asset_Tasks
nodes.notes: Reads every row. row_number is returned so the final write-back is exact, no key lookups.

nodes.name: Sheets: Style_Rules
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for specs, prompts, fill targets and cutout flags.

nodes.name: Pipeline: Cutout + QA + Finish (local)
nodes.notes: Cutout + QA + paper-cut finish, running entirely inside n8n. Inlines docs/art-core.js (verified against the Python original) plus a zlib-only PNG codec, so no local service, tunnel or Python is needed. Returns the same JSON shape serve.py did: status / error_reason / metrics / output_base64 on pass.

nodes.name: Drive: Upload Approved
nodes.notes: Folder id comes from Config.themeFolders via the Resolve Theme Folder ID node. Files keep the <asset_id>.png name so the path is stable.

nodes.name: Raw to Base64
nodes.notes: Converts the downloaded binary into raw base64. Required on n8n Cloud, where binary data is offloaded to object storage and $binary.data.data is undefined. serve.py accepts the value without a data: prefix.
